questions.q_en: Find the least number which when divided by 8, 10, 15, 18 and 20 leaves remainder 2 in each case.
questions.solution_en:
Required number = (LCM of 8, 10, 15, 18, 20) + 2

Factors of 8 = 23

Factors of 10 = 2 * 5

Factors of 15 = 3 * 5

Factors of 18 = 2 * 32

Factors of 20 = 22 * 5

LCM = 23 * 32 * 5 = 360

Required number = 360 + 2 = 362

questions.q_en: Pipe Q can fill the tank in 4 hours while pipe R can empty the tank in 10 hours. First pipe Q is opened for 3 hours then it was closed and after that pipe R is opened for 2 hours, then what part of the tank will be filled?
questions.solution_en:
Let total capacity of tank = LCM of 4 and 10 = 20

Part of tank filled by pipe Q in 1 hour = 20/4 = 5 units

Part of tank emptied by pipe R in 1 hour = 2 units

Part of tank filled = (5 * 3 - 2 * 2)/20 = 11/20

questions.q_en: In a circle with center O, TX and TY are tangents to the circle at X and Y respectively, from an external point T. If ∠ XOY = 108°, then what is the measure of ∠ OTY?
questions.solution_en:
In Δ OXY,

OX = OY

So, ∠ OXY = ∠ OYX

∠ OXY + ∠ OYX + ∠ YOX = 180

2 * ∠ OXY = 180 - 108

∠ OXY = 36°

We know that,

∠ XTY = 2 * ∠ OXY = 2 * 36 = 72°

And ∠ OTY = ∠ XTY/2 = 72/2 = 36°

questions.q_en: The average weight of three men is increased by 4 kg when one of them, whose weight is 100 kg, is replaced by another man. What is the weight of the new man?
questions.solution_en:
Let the weight of the new man = n

Let the average weight of the three men = m

Total weight of the three men = 3m

Average weight of the three men after replacement = m + 4

Total weight of the three men after replacement = 3(m + 4)

3m - 100 + n = 3(m + 4)

n = 100 + 12 = 112kg

So, the weight of the new man = 112kg

questions.q_en: Ravi and Sanju together can do a job in 2 days, Sanju and Mahesh can do it in 4 days, while Ravi and Mahesh can do it in 2 days. What is the number of days required for Ravi to do the same job alone?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 2, 4 and 2 = 4 units

Efficiency of Ravi + Sanju = 4/2 = 2 ----(1)

Efficiency of Mahesh + Sanju = 4/4 = 1 ----(2)

Efficiency of Ravi + Mahesh = 4/2 = 2 ------(3)

eqn (1) + eqn(3) - eqn(2):

2 * Efficiency of Ravi = 2 + 2 - 1 = 3

Efficiency of Ravi = 3/2

Time taken by Ravi = 4/(3/2) = 8/3 days

questions.q_en: Two motorists start together to travel to a certain destination, one at the speed of 4 km/h and the other at the speed of 6 km/h. Find the distance travelled by them (in km) if the motorist travelling at 4 km/h arrives half an hour after the other motorist.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time taken by faster motorist = 't' hours

According to the question:

6t = 4(t + 0.5)

6t = 4t + 2

2t = 2

t = 1 hour

hence, distance travelled by them = 6t

= 6 km

questions.q_en: Two inlet pipes P and Q together can fill a tank in 10 minutes. If pipe P alone can fill the tank in 22.5 minutes, then in how many minutes pipe Q alone can fill the tank completely?
questions.solution_en:
Part filled by P and Q together in one minute = 1/10

Part filled by P in one minute = 1/22.5

Time taken by Q = 1/(1/10 - 1/22.5) = 90/(9 - 4) = 18 minutes

questions.q_en: In a forest, tigers and parrots are in the ratio 7: 5 respectively and together they have 60 heads. Find the number of legs of tigers and parrots together in the forest.
questions.solution_en:
We know, each tiger has 1 head and 4 legs while each parrot has 1 head and 2 legs.

Let there are 7a tigers and 5a parrots in the forest. Then,

7a + 5a = 60

12a = 60

a = 5

Therefore, number of legs of tigers and parrots together in the forest = 4 * 7a + 2 * 5a

= 38a

= 38 * 5

= 190

questions.q_en: What is the value of (sin 300° x sin 240°) - (tan 300° x tan 240°)
questions.solution_en:
(sin 300° x sin 240°) - (tan 300° x tan 240°)

= (sin (270° +30°) x sin (270° - 30°))- (tan (270° + 30°) x tan (270° -30°))

= ((-cos 30°) x (-cos 30°) - ((-cot 30°) x (cot 30°))

= cos2 30° - (-cot2 30°)

= (3/4) + 3 = 3.75
